title: Jubilant Crispy German Sausage Casserole
description: A flexitarian-friendly German dish featuring crispy sausage and graham cracker crust, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, cook the German sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes
In a large bowl, combine the cooked sausage, sauerkraut, caraway seeds, onion, and potato
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg and milk
Add the egg mixture to the sausage mixture and stir until combined
In a hot-pot vessel, arrange a layer of the sausage mixture
Sprinkle a layer of shredded cheese over the sausage mixture
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top
Sprinkle the graham cracker crumbs over the top layer of cheese
Dot the top of the casserole with butter
Place the hot-pot vessel in a larger baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the vessel
Bake the casserole in a bain-marie for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set
